tagline: Your pocket console for the mesh.
description: CardMesh is a keyboard-first pocket client for MeshMonitor, Meshtastic, and MeshCore, built for the M5Stack CardputerZero — the first CardputerZero client targeting all three. This release (v0.1.0) ships the MeshMonitor-based Dashboard; direct Meshtastic/MeshCore support via the onboard LoRa hat is planned.
